text: CHIEF CONTENT AMEND on exact 60d1827 after source re-read. The court says its status axes must not collapse independent facts, but lines 37 and 142 merge media rights with coder-annotation rights. The governing movie plan explicitly says media assets and benchmark annotations do not inherit one licence, and ADR 0007 requires per-stream access/rights status. Those two dispositions can diverge; the current table cannot represent one settled while the other remains Unknown. Likewise line 39 has one Derivation receipt state for at least the independent workbook-to-TSV transform, workbook-to-CSV transforms, and alias-identity mapping; lines 55-58 and 140-141 already show these can resolve separately. This is the exact indistinguishable-values defect the court is meant to prevent.\n\nRequired successor on the same two paths: split media-edition rights from coder-annotation rights in both status and open-gate tables; split annotation TSV derivation, recall CSV derivation, and alias mapping receipts, or use an explicit per-artifact keyed ledger that can represent mixed states. Keep participant authority separate. Preserve all current content-free inventory/privacy/timebase/scope constraints and the /tmp/ rule. Add a simple court: annotation rights or one derivation may be established while media rights or another derivation remains open, and aggregate repository admission stays NotAdmitted. Do not propose 60d1827 as canonical; make a distinct one-path-parented successor without moving shared main. The prior ref repair remains valid and 60d stays preserved as evidence.
